dialogue.en_pron: You never tried to impress anyone.

dialogue.text: I didn't know I was supposed to.
dialogue.zh: I didn't know I was supposed to.
dialogue.ja: そうすべきだとは知りませんでした。
dialogue.local: I didn't know I was supposed to.
dialogue.en: I didn't know I was supposed to.
dialogue.local_pron: I didn't know I was supposed to.
dialogue.en_pron: I didn't know I was supposed to.

dialogue.ja: では、これが私の最後の言葉です。
約束は果たされました。

dialogue.text: The princess will be your wife.
dialogue.zh: The princess will be your wife.
dialogue.ja: 王女はあなたの妻になります。
dialogue.local: The princess will be your wife.
dialogue.en: The princess will be your wife.
dialogue.local_pron: The princess will be your wife.
dialogue.en_pron: The princess will be your wife.

dialogue.text: You caused quite a disruption in my life.
dialogue.zh: You caused quite a disruption in my life.
dialogue.ja: あなたは私の人生にかなりの混乱をもたらしました。
dialogue.local: You caused quite a disruption in my life.
dialogue.en: You caused quite a disruption in my life.
dialogue.local_pron: You caused quite a disruption in my life.
dialogue.en_pron: You caused quite a disruption in my life.

dialogue.ja: そうするつもりはありませんでした。
わかっています。

dialogue.text: You are not what I expected.
dialogue.zh: You are not what I expected.
dialogue.ja: あなたは私が期待していた人ではありません。
dialogue.local: You are not what I expected.
dialogue.en: You are not what I expected.
dialogue.local_pron: You are not what I expected.
dialogue.en_pron: You are not what I expected.

dialogue.text: But perhaps you are what this kingdom needs.
dialogue.zh: But perhaps you are what this kingdom needs.
dialogue.ja: しかし、おそらくあなたはこの王国に必要な存在です。
dialogue.local: But perhaps you are what this kingdom needs.
dialogue.en: But perhaps you are what this kingdom needs.
dialogue.local_pron: But perhaps you are what this kingdom needs.
dialogue.en_pron: But perhaps you are what this kingdom needs.

dialogue.text: With witness of this kingdom, I pronounce you married.
dialogue.zh: With witness of this kingdom, I pronounce you married.
dialogue.ja: この王国の証人として、あなたたちを結婚と宣言します。
dialogue.local: With witness of this kingdom, I pronounce you married.
dialogue.en: With witness of this kingdom, I pronounce you married.
dialogue.local_pron: With witness of this kingdom, I pronounce you married.
dialogue.en_pron: With witness of this kingdom, I pronounce you married.

dialogue.text: Try not to start another parade.
dialogue.zh: Try not to start another parade.
dialogue.ja: またパレードを始めないようにしてください。
dialogue.local: Try not to start another parade.
dialogue.en: Try not to start another parade.
dialogue.local_pron: Try not to start another parade.
dialogue.en_pron: Try not to start another parade.

dialogue.ja: 約束はできません。

dialogue.text: I shall never grab a stranger again.
dialogue.zh: I shall never grab a stranger again.
dialogue.ja: もう二度と見知らぬ人を掴みません。
dialogue.local: I shall never grab a stranger again.
dialogue.en: I shall never grab a stranger again.
dialogue.local_pron: I shall never grab a stranger again.
dialogue.en_pron: I shall never grab a stranger again.

dialogue.ja: 書類なしでは絶対にダメです。
